description: This Java class implements the PermissionWritePlatformService interface, providing functionality to update maker-checker permissions for user roles within the Fineract platform. It handles permission retrieval, validation, and persistence, with caching eviction to ensure data consistency.

classes.name: PermissionWritePlatformServiceJpaRepositoryImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the PermissionWritePlatformService interface, providing permission update logic with caching and transactional support.

methods.name: updateMakerCheckerPermissions
methods.description: Updates maker-checker permissions based on a JSON command, validates permissions, and persists changes with cache eviction.

methods.name: findPermissionInCollectionByCode
methods.description: Finds a Permission object within a collection by its code; throws exception if not found.
